description: This file contains a React component plugin for Lexical editor that manages auto-embedding features like YouTube videos and Tweets, including configuration objects, UI components, and modal logic for embedding URLs.

classes.name: PlaygroundEmbedConfig
classes.description: Interface extending EmbedConfig with additional metadata for embedding content such as name, icon, example URL, keywords, and description.

classes.name: AutoEmbedMenuItem
classes.description: React component rendering a menu item for auto-embed options, handling hover and click events.

classes.name: AutoEmbedMenu
classes.description: React component rendering a list of auto-embed options within a menu.

classes.name: AutoEmbedDialog
classes.description: Modal dialog component allowing user to input URLs for embedding, with validation and callbacks.

methods.name: AutoEmbedPlugin
methods.description: Main React component that registers the auto-embed plugin with configuration, manages modal dialogs and menu options for embedding URLs.

methods.name: openEmbedModal
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog for a specific embed configuration.

methods.name: getMenuOptions
methods.description: Returns menu options for embedding actions, such as dismiss and embed.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Utility function to debounce user input for URL validation.
